integrity: Exact algebraic proof of the finite-size gain and sign classification; reproducible independent exact-rational tests. Priority and external validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one pre-signal delegation, two signal states, conditionally independent votes, homogeneous background voter competence, binary correct option, odd electorates. No multiple-delegation or strategic generalization.
